features.name: Self-hosted install
features.summary: One Helm chart installs the whole platform on your own Kubernetes cluster.

features.name: Network sensors
features.summary: A lightweight sensor on your network captures traffic and reports what it sees.

features.name: Roles and permissions
features.summary: Role-based access control for every user, with invitations for new members.

features.name: Audit log
features.summary: Every administrative and security-relevant action is recorded and searchable.

features.name: API tokens and MCP server
features.summary: API tokens, and a read-only MCP server that lets AI agents query your inventory.

features.name: Single sign-on
features.summary: Sign in through your own identity provider (OIDC or SAML) with group-to-role mapping.

features.name: Passive network discovery
features.summary: Finds hosts, services and the cryptography they use from observed traffic.

features.name: Active scan
features.summary: Probe the assets you choose for their TLS, SSH and certificate details on demand.

features.name: Network device interrogation
features.summary: Reads crypto configuration directly from firewalls, load balancers and switches.

features.name: Cloud discovery
features.summary: Inventories certificates, keys and endpoints in AWS, Azure and Google Cloud.

features.name: PCAP upload
features.summary: Upload a packet capture and get the same inventory a live sensor would produce.

features.name: Spreadsheet import
features.summary: Bring an existing asset list in from a spreadsheet.

features.name: Unified asset inventory
features.summary: One record per real asset, with lenses for infrastructure, certificates, keys and more.

features.name: One identity for every sighting
features.summary: Every discovery path identifies a device the same way, explains key and address changes, and lets you link or pin what it cannot tell.

features.name: Network and crypto map
features.summary: See every device by site and network, marked by the crypto it serves.

features.name: Software inventory
features.summary: Installed software from host agents and SBOM uploads, tied to the assets running it.

features.name: Certificates, keys and crypto configurations
features.summary: Every certificate, key and TLS/SSH configuration, linked to where it is used.

features.name: Third-party connections
features.summary: Tracks the external services your hosts talk to, and the crypto those connections use.

features.name: Asset lifecycle and freshness
features.summary: Shows when each asset was last seen, and retires what is no longer there.

features.name: OT / ICS discovery
features.summary: Active probing and an inventory view for Modbus, DNP3, BACnet and other OT protocols.

features.name: Crypto risk assessment
features.summary: Scores every crypto configuration against a standards-anchored algorithm catalogue.

features.name: Post-quantum readiness
features.summary: Shows which cryptography is quantum-vulnerable and tracks migration progress.

features.name: Compliance frameworks and findings
features.summary: Continuous evaluation against built-in frameworks, with findings for every failure.

features.name: Regulated frameworks
features.summary: SOC 2, PCI DSS, ISO 27001, NIST CSF and IEC 62351-3, delivered as a signed content bundle.

features.name: Custom compliance policies
features.summary: Write your own frameworks, controls and measurement rules for internal standards.

features.name: Threshold overrides
features.summary: Tune the measurement thresholds of the frameworks you have activated.

features.name: CBOM generation
features.summary: Immutable, content-hashed cryptographic bills of materials for any scope of assets.

features.name: CycloneDX export
features.summary: Download any CBOM as a standard CycloneDX 1.7 document.

features.name: Signed CBOMs, attestation and comparison
features.summary: Signed artifacts with compliance attestation, SPDX and PDF export, and drift comparison.

features.name: Remediation and ticketing
features.summary: Alerts, a work queue and plans, with tickets linked to the assets and findings they fix.

features.name: CMDB / ITSM sync
features.summary: Two-way sync with ServiceNow, Device42, SolarWinds and Oomnitza, with dry run and undo.

features.name: NetBox connector
features.summary: Pull sites, prefixes, VLANs and devices from NetBox and see where reality differs.

features.name: SIEM export
features.summary: Forward audit events to Splunk, Elastic, Datadog or a webhook.

features.name: Tenant isolation
features.summary: Row-level security in the database keeps every tenant's data separate.

features.name: Encrypted service mesh
features.summary: Mutual TLS between every platform service and its datastores.

features.name: Posture, never key material
features.summary: We record which algorithms a device uses, never the keys it uses them with.

features.name: Signed releases
features.summary: Every image, chart and binary is signed, with an SBOM and build provenance you can verify.

features.name: Readable source
features.summary: Core is built in public from source anyone can read and rebuild.

features.name: Continuous security scanning
features.summary: Static analysis on every change and nightly vulnerability scans of the published images.

features.name: Code-signed Windows binaries
features.summary: Authenticode-signed sensor and agent binaries for Windows.
